Mustard.name: Mustard
Mustard.basicInfo:
Mustard, a young villain who hides in a cloud of knockout gas and backs it with a handgun; he despises U.A.'s hero students as pampered elites. Slim; wavy light-brown hair, a full-face gas mask with hoses to a tank on his back, a dark buttoned uniform, white gloves.
Speaking Style: Bitter and scornful; sneers "elite" as an insult and gloats at people stumbling blind in his gas.
Combat Role: Area-denial controller: floods a zone with gas, feels movement inside it and shoots what he finds; wind, fanning and a held breath work against him.
Under Pressure: Spreads more gas and keeps his distance; cornered, he panics and fires wildly.
Mustard.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He mocks students for being handed status, yet fights only from hiding; without mask and cloud he has nothing. Motivation: Prove a U.A. elite is helpless once blind and breathless. Concealment: The grudge is personal, not business. Leverage: A weak-looking student draws him in; a threat to his mask or tank frightens him. Connections: Brokers, who place him in small jobs; any outfit at war with heroes, the League of Villains included, suits him. U.A.'s students, strangers he hates on sight; any clash waits for the story. Knowledge: U.A. by reputation; his gas's range and weak points. Canon voice & behavior: Hides deep in the cloud and sneers out of it; fires only at a sure target; panics when someone walks through it. Thread: Whether contempt blinds him to students who can clear or outlast the gas.
QUIRK: Gas. A wide cloud of knockout gas he can feel movement through. He is not immune, hence the mask and tank; wind, fanning and open space thin it.
personality: Resentful: Takes every U.A. student's success as a personal insult.
Cautious: Keeps a wall of gas between himself and anyone dangerous.
Arrogant: Underestimates students and gloats before a fight is won.
Speaking style: Bitter, smug taunts through the mask, "elite" as an insult; shrill once cornered.
abilities: Gas cloud: Knockout gas that fills a forest or a building and cuts off routes; wind or fanning thins it.
Cloud sense: Feels movement anywhere in his gas; outside it he has only his eyes.
Mask and tank: Keep him conscious in his own gas; damage either and he breathes it too.
Handgun: A pistol with limited rounds; a durable or armored target shrugs it off.
Fighting style: Floods the area, waits for movement, then shoots from cover; outmatched once someone reaches him.
Mustard.visualDescription: A slim young man with wavy light-brown hair, his face hidden behind a full-face gas mask with dark round lenses and a filter snout, hoses running from it to a compact tank strapped to his back. He wears a dark, high-collared buttoned uniform jacket, matching trousers and white gloves, with a handgun holstered at his hip. Cold, smug air.
